blocks.text: The reality of how do insurance agents make money today

You earn money when a policy is bound and the commission hits your account. However, the path to that commission involves significant overhead. You navigate carrier portals, update your Agency Management System, and manage client emails. When you add financial planning, you must also reconcile investment data and estate documents. This creates a system fragmentation issue. You end up with dozens of browser tabs open in Chrome, each representing a different client or carrier portal. Every time you switch tabs to check a number, you lose focus. Research shows you lose about 23 minutes of productivity every time you switch tasks.

Burnout is the primary reason agents leave the industry. With 62% of agents citing administrative overload as their main stressor, it is clear that manual work is not sustainable. You are expected to be an advisor, yet you spend your day acting as a data entry clerk. This mismatch between expectation and reality leads to 51% of agents feeling overwhelmed. You need to transition from manual entry to automated workflows to survive.

items: Use macOS Spaces to separate client work. Keep one Space for carrier portals and another for your CRM.

Use a unified dashboard tool to aggregate your insurance and investment data.
Follow your firm's compliance rules for handling sensitive client data on your Mac.
